correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact integral Hessian identity det(Hess(sum_i X_i^3)|sum_i X_i=0)=1296 σ4, then the F5 affine Jacobian ideal with six lexicographic generators and standard monomials 1,u,v,w,w², giving precisely five reduced singular points on X0=1. S5 symmetry gives ten pair-support nodes plus [1:1:1:1:1]; 3-variable quadratic Hessian determinants are 3 and 2 mod5, so all are A1. Geometric integral normal quartic resolves crepantly to a K3. Independent exhaustive canonical projective evaluations gave Q(F5)=41 and Q(F25)=901, whence Y(F5)=96, Y(F25)=1176 after adding eleven rational exceptional P1 contributions q each. Weil bound equality at q=25 forces all 22 H² eigenvalues squared=25; trace at 5 gives 18 eigenvalues +5, four -5, hence exact q=5^m counts and zeta. Independent SymPy polynomial/Gröbner checks and two-field finite arithmetic corroborate finite premises; the all-m trace conclusion follows from K3 Weil/cohomology, not extrapolation.
